g.title: ABPA_QSP
g.text: Allergic Bronchopulmonary Aspergillosis — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
the fungal population is partitioned into a drug-accessible lumen and a drug-inaccessible mucus plug;
every therapy is classified by which term of that partition it touches
solid = mass flux / activation · dashed = modulation · dotted = inhibition · bold red = the sanctuary loop · diamond = clinical endpoint

g.title: DDI_CONFOUND
g.text: itraconazole inhibits CYP3A4, so part of its
apparent steroid-sparing effect is a DDI —
each mg of steroid acts like several.
The magnitude depends on WHICH steroid,

g.title: LEG2
g.text: E_af in F_LUM fully, in F_PLUG × f_pen ≈ 0.10
E_af at the mucosal surface; no CYP3A4 DDI
FcεRI occupancy only; PLUG barely, F_PLUG not at all
MUC5AC drive down → PLUG down → k_out up → lowers
the azole eradication threshold E* (not Bliss synergy)
sets F_PLUG and PLUG to ~0 instantaneously
